title: Routing the OS2mo demo through the OS2 cooperative makes it shared municipal infrastructure, not one client project
content:
The demo starts from an event Magenta's own product already emits. When an organisational change happens in OS2mo, that change is dispatched as a typed operation, so what gets stored is an attributed, replayable record of the change rather than the new state of a row. No new trigger has to be invented for the seam to exist.

The distinctive part of this design is not the technical seam but the route to adoption. Proposing the integration through the OS2 cooperative means it is evaluated as shared municipal infrastructure, not as one client's customisation. The artefact and the channel are chosen together: the same adapter, offered privately, would be a single project.

Commercially that is the whole point. A per-client integration has to be re-sold at every engagement, while something the cooperative adopts is specified once and inherited by its members. The research selects the cooperative route explicitly for that reason, which makes this demo as much a distribution decision as an engineering one.
